sections.text:

Aug 2024 LTIMindtree | Bangalore Senior Business Analyst
Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate business
requirements into scalable BI solutions and executive dashboards.
Designed and developed 12+ Power BI dashboards and KPI scorecards, enabling
data driven decision-making and improving reporting efficiency by 25%.
Analyzed large datasets using SQL, Snowflake, AWS Glue, and AWS S3 to identify improvement bottlenecks,
business

operational

opportunities.
Automated recurring business reports using Power Query and Advanced Excel, saving

by 18% and ensuring reliable business insights.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to deliver analytical solutions, support UAT,
and drive continuous process improvement initiatives.
04/2021 - 09/2023 Wells Fargo| Bangalore Senior Data Management Analyst
Collaborated with 20+ business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document
business requirements for 15+ process improvement initiatives, improving operational
efficiency by 18%.
Prepared 30+ Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement
Documents (FRDs), process requirement approval.
flows, and user stories, ensuring 95%

opportunities that reduced process turnaround time by 22%.

Testing (UAT) cycles, achieving a 98% defect resolution rate before production
deployment.
Developed 20+ SQL queries and 10+ Power BI dashboards to monitor KPIs, SLA
compliance, and operational performance, reducing manual reporting effort by 35%.

improving reporting accuracy by 99% and reducing data quality issues by 20%.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops and requirement review sessions with cross-

significantly reducing manual reporting effort.
Conducted data validation and reconciliation to ensure the accuracy of payroll, GST,
receivables, and financial reports.
Delivered ad hoc business reports and analytical insights to support financial planning
and business decision-making.
Improved reporting processes by standardizing templates and enhancing reporting
quality.
